# PDFTara

> PDFTara offers free, private PDF tools in the browser and a free desktop app, PDFTara Studio, for Windows, macOS and Linux.

## PDFTara Studio (desktop app)
- Page: https://www.pdftara.com/en/desktop/
- Free, local-first PDF app. Files are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded.
- Features: 53+ PDF tools, visual workflow studio, offline AI copilot (Ollama, LM Studio), in-place text editing.
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux (AppImage, .deb).

## Online PDF tools
- Tools: https://www.pdftara.com/en/tools/
- Studio (web): https://www.pdftara.com/en/studio/
- FAQ: https://www.pdftara.com/en/faq/
